title: AI智能体间的信任：形成、破裂与恢复的测量及其对多智能体系统治理的意义
summary: 提出基于代价验证的行为测量方法，研究AI智能体间信任的形成、破裂与恢复。实验发现，不同模型在信任建立和恢复上存在显著差异，信任校准而非最大怀疑应成为多智能体系统治理的核心关注点。
summary_en: Proposes a behavioral measure based on costly verification to study trust formation, breakage, and recovery between AI agents. Experiments show significant differences across models, suggesting trust calibration, not maximal suspicion, should be the central governance concern for multi-agent systems.
